items.t: Man convicted in deadly downtown Orlando Halloween mass shooting to learn sentence
items.x: Jaylen Edgar, a man convicted of killing two people during a 2024 Halloween shooting in downtown Orlando, could learn his punishment on Tuesday.

items.t: Hernando County deputies seek answers in 2017 disappearance, death of pregnant woman
items.x: The Hernando County Sheriff’s Office is asking the public for new information regarding the 2017 disappearance and death of Stevencia Barlatier, a pregnant Orlando-area resident whose body was later found in rural Hernando County.

items.t: ‘Read me the code’: A fake bank call cost an Orlando couple more than $7,500
items.x: The caller said they were from their bank and asked for a code. Here’s how the scam worked and why the couple’s case is a warning for anyone who gets a similar call.

items.t: Orlando weather: Gusty winds and dangerous surf for Central Florida
items.x: Another windy day across Central Florida, with northeast winds of 20-25 mph and frequent gusts of 35-40 mph, especially near the coast.

items.t: Winter Park police respond to dispute between soccer league officials, player's family

items.t: Orange County considers 1,000-foot buffer between future smoke shops and schools
items.x: Orange County commissioners are considering a proposal to keep future smoke shops at least 1,000 feet from schools, sparking a debate over whether the restrictions would help protect children and reduce underage smoking and vaping.

items.t: Pro wrestler Amber Nova Flora arrested in Orlando after refusing DUI breath test
items.x: Orlando police arrested pro wrestler Amber Nova Flora on Friday following her refusal to undergo DUI testing.

items.t: New Center for Women and Families set to break ground in Orlando this week

items.t: Orlando’s nurses need a path forward. Local employers can help build it.

items.t: 2026 ballot measures are written at a graduate-school reading level, report finds

items.t: Border patrol agents seen at Florida polls wanted to vote, officials say
